usageNotes: Use this to update the contact email addresses registered with an existing ACME account on Proxmox Datacenter Manager; the account must already exist (create it first with the POST variant). Requires the 'System.Modify' privilege on the system/certificates path. The call is asynchronous — it returns a UPID that must be polled to confirm the update was applied at the ACME CA.

examples.summary: Update the contact email for the default ACME account

tips: The 'contact' field accepts a comma-separated list of email addresses; most ACME CAs use this for expiry and revocation notices.
Poll the returned UPID via the task log endpoint to confirm the remote ACME CA accepted the contact update — a local 200 response does not mean the CA has acknowledged it.
Account names must match the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ — avoid spaces or special characters.
Omitting the 'contact' body field sends an empty update; include at least one valid email to ensure renewal notifications are delivered.
